player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitākaro {player_id}. Kei te tākaro koe i te whai i ngā waka.
Ko tō whāinga ko te whakawhati i ngā waka katoa o tō hoariri mai i te whakawhati i ngā waka ou.
I tō wā, ka taea e koe te tuku i ngā manuka ki ngā whēnua whakapapa i te whiriwhiri e whai ake nei: '[a4]'. Ki te pā te manuka i tētahi waka, ka tohua ki 'X'. Ki te haere atu, ka tohua ki 'O'. I ngā whakaaturanga e rua, ka whakaatu te taiao o te whai i ō pānga. Ki te kua whakawhati koe i tētahi poti, ka kōrero te taiao o te whai ki a koe!
Ka mutu te whai ina whakawhati ngā waka katoa o tētahi o ngā kaitākaro.
Ka whakapapahia tō papa whakapapa tuatahi ka whakapapahia ngā waka katoa o koe, me ngā pānga o tō hoariri ki a koe, me ō pānga me ō haere atu ki runga o tō papa whakapapa o tō hoariri, ki te kore e whakapapahia ngā waka o tō hoariri.
Ko te papa whakapapa tuatahi kei konei:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kāore te kaitākaro i whakautu ki tētahi taunga tika kei roto i ngā āpitihanga tapawhā.
invalid_move.out_of_board: Ko te {coord} e noho ana i waho o te papa.
invalid_move.already_fired: Kua oti te patu ki runga i te {coord}.

{view}

Kua whakawhati te hoariri i tō waka ki {coord}! Ko tō papa whakapapa kua whakahoutia:
{view}

{view}
game_action.opp_hit:

outcome.win: Kua whakangaromia e te kaitākaro {player_id} ngā kaipuke katoa o tōna hoariri!
